description: This file defines the TeamBillingService class which manages billing operations for teams, including subscription management, payment checks, seat updates, and billing state transitions in a TypeScript project.

classes.name: TeamBillingService
classes.description: A service class that handles billing operations for teams, including subscription management, payment processing, seat updates, and billing state transitions.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the team's subscription and downgrades the billing status.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Handles the publishing process for a team, including payment checks and initiating checkout sessions.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Downgrades the team's billing status by clearing payment and subscription metadata.

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Updates the number of seats for the team based on seat change type.

methods.name: checkIfTeamPaymentRequired
methods.description: Checks if the team needs to make a payment, returning a URL if payment is required.

methods.name: getSubscriptionStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current subscription status for the team.

methods.name: endTrial
methods.description: Ends the team's trial period, converting it to a regular subscription.

methods.name: saveTeamBilling
methods.description: Saves billing information for the team in the repository.
